text:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV2: spike in 5xx and timeouts at api-gateway (us-west). 5xx rate ~12% over last 3m (baseline <1%). P95 latency increased. Paging oncall: @Jamal :pager:

Jamal: I'm on it. On call for SRE this shift, pulling up traces/dashboards now. Any idea scope? Is this global or only us-west?

Sophie: From logs I'm seeing error responses from upstream service "model-proxy" with 502/504. But logs are sparse — most requests have no request_id and traces are sampled at 0.1%, so hard to correlate. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd/api-gateway (shortlink)

Leo: Noticed a gateway deploy ~18m ago (rollout: api-gateway:v2.7.2). Could be config change. Rolling back is an option but want a faster stopgap.

Maria: Any customer-facing impact? CS is getting tickets about timeouts in production for some tenants.

Jamal: Quick customer impact check: looking at request volume and affected routes. Top affected route: /v1/generate (traffic -> 30% errors). Customers with longer seq lengths hit more. I'll split traffic to canary region and scale replicas.

Jamal: Immediate mitigations I'm going to do now:
- scale api-gateway to 5 -> kubectl scale deploy api-gateway --replicas=5
- enable request_id injection at gateway proxy config
- bump trace sampling for /v1/generate to 100% for 10m
- add temporary debug header to upstream to surface error reasons

Jamal: Patching configmap to enable request ids and trace sampling:
```
kubectl patch cm gateway-config -n prod -p '{"data":{"inject_request_id":"true","trace_sample_rate":"1.0","debug_routes":"/v1/generate"}}'
```

Sophie: +1 on request_id. Right now downstream logs don't include a request id key so it's impossible to join. If we can inject X-Request-ID at the proxy and have upstream echo it, we can correlate logs across services.

Leo: I'm going to temporarily route 25% of traffic for /v1/generate to eu-central to reduce pressure on us-west. Command: `kubectl apply -f traffic-shift.yaml` (will push in 90s). Also holding any further gateway deploys.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: traffic-shift (sha: f2c3) — ETA 90s

Jamal: Adding immediate verbose logging to gateway pods (env LOG_LEVEL=debug) for 10m and rotate logs after. Also adding a small middleware to add X-Debug:1 header when header `x-redwood-debug` present. Patch:
```
# nginx snippet
proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
proxy_set_header X-Debug $http_x_redwood_debug;
```

Sophie: Observability gaps noted for post-incident items:
- no request_id propagated consistently across services
- trace sampling too low for high-volume routes
- metrics missing per-route 5xx counts (only aggregated gateway 5xx)
- some services drop traceparent header on error paths

Maria: Customer impact summary for CS: "Some customers experienced elevated timeouts/5xx on /v1/generate for ~12m starting at 1778604123. We are routing traffic away from affected region and increased retries. We'll follow up with a root-cause once postmortem is complete."

Jamal: Current status: scaling finished, trace sampling bumped, request_id injection live in prod (replicated to 3 pods). Error rate dropping from 12% -> 3% in last 4m. Still seeing intermittent 502s from model-proxy. Next steps: rollback gateway deploy if errors persist, deeper debug on model-proxy logs once request_id present. Assigning owners:
- Action: Post-incident instrumentation (request_id propagation, per-route 5xx metric) -> Owner: Sophie
- Action: Root cause on model-proxy 502s -> Owner: Leo
- Action: Customer comms and ticket triage -> Owner: Maria

Jamal: Handoff to next oncall in 10m: @Sophie will take over monitoring and RCA. Leaving probe commands and links in the ticket.

Sophie: Taking oncall handoff. I'll keep the thread updated and open a follow-up channel for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
